chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Murazim, who said:
I saw Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): when he performed ablution before eating, he did not touch the cloth; and when he performed ablution after eating, he touched the cloth.
ai.seo_question: What is the ritual etiquette regarding touching a cloth during ablution before and after eating according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration highlights the practical application of ritual purity (taharah) in daily sustenance, distinguishing between the state before and after eating. The Imam’s deliberate variation in touching the cloth underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on maintaining physical cleanliness as an act of worship, linking bodily hygiene with spiritual mindfulness during meals.
